    Chazadi "Chit-Chat" Wright is a 5'4" sophomore point guard for the Iowa Hawkeyes (2025-26 season), known as a skilled, explosive scorer and playmaker who transferred from Georgia Tech. She earned her nickname for being quiet as a child in AAU and is recognized for her buzzer-beating ability and high-pressure tournament performance. 
    This video shows a behind-the-scenes look at Chit-Chat Wright before a game:
    02:33
    Hawk Central
    YouTube• Mar 23, 2026
    Key Details About Chit-Chat Wright: 
    • Transfer & Role: After a strong freshman year at Georgia Tech, she transferred to Iowa for the 2025-26 season, becoming a key contributor and frequently listed as a starting point guard
      .
    • Style of Play: Described as a "passionate playmaker" and a "sparkplug" with the ability to create her own shot, often acting as a second scoring option for the Hawkeyes.
    • Background: Originally from Atlanta, Georgia, she attended Wesleyan School, where she was a four-star recruit by ESPN HoopGurlz and a 1,000-point scorer.
    • Nickname Origin: She received the nickname "Chit-Chat" at age 10 because she was unusually quiet on her first AAU team, according to a Hawk Central article.
    • Notable Performances: She has been recognized for significant 20+ point games against Iowa State and Northern Iowa, as well as a memorable half-court buzzer-beater.
